title: The Bible: Old and New Testament
examples: How many books are in the Bible?
What is the difference between the Old and New Testament?

explain.say: The Bible is the sacred scripture of Christians. Its name comes from the Greek word for books, because it is really a library: 66 books in most Protestant Bibles and 73 in Catholic Bibles.

It has two main parts. The Old Testament, shared in large part with the Jewish Bible, tells of creation, Abraham, Moses and the prophets; the New Testament tells of the life and teaching of Jesus and the first Christians.

a: Shared in large part with the Jewish Bible
b: The life and teaching of Jesus
The early church and its letters

explain.say: The books come in many kinds, or genres: law, history, poetry, wisdom, prophecy, the Gospels, letters and the visions of Revelation. Reading it is like walking along a bookshelf of very different books.

items: Poetry and wisdom | Psalms, Proverbs, Job
Letters and vision | Romans, Corinthians, Revelation

draw.text: Psalms is the longest book, with 150 psalms

explain.say: The four Gospels, Matthew, Mark, Luke and John, tell the story of Jesus. Christians believe he was born in Bethlehem, grew up in Nazareth, and died and rose again in Jerusalem, and his followers carried the message across the Roman world.

draw.label: Places of the Gospels, and journeys of the early church

explain.say: The Bible was written by many authors over more than a thousand years. Scholars date the oldest Old Testament writings to around 1000 BCE or later and the New Testament to roughly 50 to 100 CE, beginning with the letters of Paul.

items: About 1000 to 200 BCE: Hebrew scriptures written and gathered
About 50 to 100 CE: New Testament written
Late 300s CE: Jerome's Latin Bible, the Vulgate
1611: the King James Version in English

draw.text: Christians believe the writers were inspired by God

explain.say: Today the complete Bible has been translated into more than 700 languages, more than any other book. Christians read it in church and at home for prayer, guidance and worship.

draw.text: The Dead Sea Scrolls, found in 1947, hold the oldest known copies of Hebrew Bible books

faq.q: How many books are in the Bible?
faq.a: Most Protestant Bibles have 66 books: 39 in the Old Testament and 27 in the New Testament. Catholic Bibles have 73, because they include seven more Old Testament books, and Orthodox Bibles include a few more still.
asks: How many books does the Bible have?
Why do Catholic Bibles have more books?
How many books are in the Old Testament?

faq.a: The Gospels are the first four books of the New Testament: Matthew, Mark, Luke and John. Gospel means good news, and each tells the life, teaching, death and resurrection of Jesus, as Christians believe it.
asks: What does Gospel mean?
Name the four Gospels
Why are there four Gospels?

faq.a: The Old Testament is the first and larger part of the Christian Bible, 39 books in Protestant Bibles. It covers creation, Abraham, Moses, the kings and the prophets, and overlaps largely with the Jewish Bible, the Tanakh.
asks: What is in the Old Testament?
How is the Old Testament different from the New Testament?
Old Testament vs New Testament

faq.a: The New Testament is the second part of the Christian Bible, 27 books written in Greek. It has the four Gospels about Jesus, the Acts of the Apostles, 21 letters, and ends with the visions of Revelation.
asks: What is in the New Testament?
What books are in the New Testament?
What is the book of Revelation?

faq.a: The Bible was written by many people over more than a thousand years: prophets, kings, poets, historians and apostles such as Paul. Christians believe these human writers were inspired by God.
asks: Who is the author of the Bible?
Did God write the Bible?
How many people wrote the Bible?

faq.q: What language was the Bible written in?
faq.a: The Old Testament was written mostly in Hebrew, with a few parts in Aramaic. The New Testament was written in Greek, the common language of the eastern Roman world.
asks: Was the Bible written in Hebrew?
What was the original language of the New Testament?
Did Jesus speak Aramaic?

faq.a: Scholars think the Old Testament books were written and gathered over many centuries, roughly from 1000 to 200 BCE. The New Testament was written between about 50 and 100 CE, starting with Paul's letters.
asks: How old is the Bible?
When was the New Testament written?
Which part of the Bible was written first?

faq.a: The epistles are the 21 letters in the New Testament, written to early churches and Christian leaders. Thirteen carry Paul's name, such as Romans and Corinthians, and others are linked with James, Peter, John and Jude.
asks: What are the letters in the Bible?
Who wrote most of the New Testament letters?
What are Paul's letters?

faq.q: What is the first book of the Bible?
faq.a: The first book is Genesis, which means beginning. It tells of the creation of the world, Adam and Eve, Noah, and the families of Abraham, Isaac, Jacob and Joseph.
asks: What is Genesis about?
How does the Bible begin?
What comes first in the Bible?

faq.q: What is the longest book in the Bible?
faq.a: The book of Psalms is the longest, with 150 psalms, poems and songs of prayer and praise. Psalm 119 is also the longest chapter in the Bible.
asks: How many psalms are there?
What are the Psalms?
Which is the biggest book of the Bible?

faq.q: What is the King James Bible?
faq.a: The King James Version is an English translation published in 1611 under King James the First. Its language shaped English literature and many common phrases, and it is still read by many Christians today.
asks: When was the King James Version made?
What is the KJV?
What is the most famous English Bible?

faq.q: How many languages has the Bible been translated into?
faq.a: The complete Bible has been translated into more than 700 languages, and the New Testament into more than 1,600. Parts of it exist in over 3,000 languages, more than any other book.
asks: Is the Bible the most translated book?
How many translations of the Bible are there?
In how many languages is the Bible?

faq.q: What are the Dead Sea Scrolls?
faq.a: The Dead Sea Scrolls are ancient Jewish manuscripts found from 1947 in caves near Qumran, by the Dead Sea. They include the oldest known copies of books of the Hebrew Bible, about a thousand years older than copies known before.
asks: When were the Dead Sea Scrolls found?
What is the oldest copy of the Bible?
Why are the Dead Sea Scrolls important?

faq.q: Who decided which books are in the Bible?
faq.a: The list of books, called the canon, took shape over centuries as communities used and agreed on texts. For the New Testament, the 27 books were widely accepted by the late 300s CE, and different churches still differ on a few Old Testament books.
asks: What is the Bible canon?
How were the books of the Bible chosen?
When was the Bible put together?

facts: Most Protestant Bibles have 66 books, 39 in the Old Testament and 27 in the New Testament; Catholic Bibles have 73.
The four Gospels are Matthew, Mark, Luke and John.
The Old Testament was written mostly in Hebrew and the New Testament in Greek.
The King James Version of the Bible was published in 1611.
The Dead Sea Scrolls, found from 1947 near Qumran, include the oldest known copies of Hebrew Bible books.

quiz.say: How many books are in the New Testament?
quiz.show: How many books are in the New Testament?
quiz.why: The New Testament has 27 books: 4 Gospels, Acts, 21 letters and Revelation. All major Christian churches agree on these 27.

wrong.0: 4 is the number of Gospels, the first part of the New Testament.
wrong.2: 39 is the number of Old Testament books in Protestant Bibles.
wrong.3: 66 is the whole Protestant Bible, both Testaments together.

quiz.say: A student wants to read the story of the life of Jesus. Which part of the Bible should she turn to?
quiz.show: Where would you read the life of Jesus?
quiz.why: The Gospels of Matthew, Mark, Luke and John tell the life and teaching of Jesus.

wrong.1: The Psalms are poems and songs of prayer from the Old Testament.
wrong.2: Genesis tells of creation and the patriarchs, long before the time of Jesus.

quiz.say: Why is it helpful to think of the Bible as a library rather than a single book?
quiz.show: Why call the Bible a library?

options.show: It has many books of different kinds
options.say: It has many books of different kinds, by many writers

options.show: It is kept only in libraries
options.say: It is kept only in libraries

options.show: It was written in one year
options.say: It was written in one year

quiz.why: The Bible holds law, history, poetry, prophecy, Gospels and letters, written over centuries, so each book is read with its own genre in mind.

wrong.1: Bibles are found in homes, churches and schools everywhere.
wrong.2: It was written over more than a thousand years.
